sources.label: NSCP 2015, Chapter 2 — Seismic Provisions for MEPF Systems
sources.description: Requires seismic bracing and flexible connections for all mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems in Seismic Zone 4.

sources.label: NSCP 2015, Section 2.12 — Non-Structural Component Seismic Requirements
sources.description: Specifies seismic force levels and bracing requirements for non-structural components including MEPF equipment, conduit, piping, and ductwork.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII — Anchorage and Bracing Requirements for Building Services
sources.description: General requirements for anchorage of building service equipment and systems to resist seismic and wind forces.
